source: nfelo b4b99b01 published forecasts and ratings + nflverse/nfldata 2026 schedule.
note: Full 2026 schedule with per-game win probabilities. `src` says where each probability came from: "nfelo" = published nfelo forecast without an extra blend; "nfelo-season" = nfelo pre-market calculation with current team/QB strength and game-specific HFA. Ownership is modelled, not observed.

field_notes.mm: Legacy margin diagnostic; not used to calculate win probabilities
field_notes.mk: market-implied home win probability (null when no line); derivation and provenance are named by mk_src
field_notes.mk_obs: when the market input was observed; null when no line
field_notes.mk_book: source book; null because the nfelo upstream output does not identify it
field_notes.season_p: nfelo pre-market logistic probability using current base ratings, QB adjustments and game-specific HFA
field_notes.season_elo_dif: Base home minus away Elo plus HFA Elo and net QB adjustment
field_notes.nfp: Published nfelo home win probability; null when unavailable. No additional market blend.
field_notes.nfelo_obs: Upstream commit timestamp for the published forecast
field_notes.p: Home win probability used: published nfelo forecast or nfelo-based full-season projection

season_projection.assumption: Current base team strength and QB adjustments held fixed for future games; game-specific HFA from nfelohfa. No extra market regression.

1.label: ETR/Splash + ESPN blend
1.note: ESPN-only teams retain their normalized ESPN share. Remaining mass blends ETR and ESPN equally. Weights are judgmental, uncalibrated; sensitivity scenarios are not confidence intervals. Week-specific; never carried into later weeks.

tier_meaning: Pup — live and useful, not yet validated. It may compute real answers and still have open questions about calibration, assumptions, data quality or edge. Everything starts here.
